exercises.originalNote: Rotate through mid back as far as comfortable.

exercises.name: Chin Tuck Lift Iso
exercises.note: Мягко подтяните подбородок, немного приподнимите голову над полом и удерживайте положение.
exercises.originalNote: Gently tuck chin, lift head slightly off ground and hold.

exercises.name: Towel Stretch
exercises.note: Мягко помогайте повороту шеи полотенцем.
exercises.originalNote: Use a towel to gently assist your neck into rotation.

exercises.name: Neck Extension Iso
exercises.note: В каждом подходе одно удержание на 20 секунд.
exercises.originalNote: Each set will be 1 reps with a 20 second hold.

exercises.name: Prone Swimmer
exercises.note: Двигайтесь медленно, удерживая руки и кисти над полом.
exercises.originalNote: Go slow, keeping arms and hands off ground.

exercises.name: Levator Scapulae Stretch
exercises.note: Удерживайте комфортное растяжение в течение указанного времени.
exercises.originalNote: Find a comfortable stretch for desired time.

exercises.name: Upper Trap Stretch
